effects: Reads the signer's whole allowance of `token` to the depository and pulls exactly that amount from the signer.
Off-chain, the deposit is credited to `depositor`, or to the signer when depositor is the zero address, under order id `id`.
formats.shown: "Deposit all approved {token} for {depositor}", with the token ticker, the credited address (shown as "Sender" for zero) and the raw order id.

findings.title: depositErc20 (allowance): the amount pulled is the on-chain allowance and no field can show it.
findings.evidence: RelayDepository.sol depositErc20(address,address,bytes32): `uint256 amount = ERC20(token).allowance(msg.sender, address(this)); depositErc20(depositor, token, amount, id);`. The descriptor's label is 'Token (all approved)' and the intent is 'Deposit all approved {token}'.
findings.fix: Nothing to fix in the descriptor. The label already says the full allowance is used.

findings.title: depositErc20 (allowance): the order id stands for off-chain Relay terms (destination, output) that the screen cannot decode.
findings.evidence: Field `id` 'Relay Order ID' (raw). The contract only emits it in RelayErc20Deposit.

effects: Records a request for the caller to become owner. The request expires after 48 hours.
Any ETH sent stays in the depository.

findings.title: requestOwnershipHandover: the intent does not say the signer asks to become owner, or that the request expires after 48h.
findings.evidence: Ownable.sol requestOwnershipHandover: `expires = block.timestamp + _ownershipHandoverValidFor()` (48 * 3600), stored for caller(). Descriptor intent: 'Request ownership handover'.

effects: Only the owner can call it. Replaces the allocator with _allocator; the zero address reverts. The allocator's signature authorizes execute(), which makes arbitrary calls and value transfers from the depository's funds.
formats.shown: "Set allocator to {_allocator}", with the new allocator's address.

findings.title: setAllocator: nothing tells the signer that the allocator can authorize any call that moves the depository's funds.
findings.evidence: RelayDepository.sol execute(): `if (!allocator.isValidSignatureNow(eip712Hash, signature)) revert` and then `c.to.call{value: c.value}(c.data)`. Descriptor intent 'Set allocator', label 'New Allocator'.
findings.fix: Intent 'Set allocator (signs all withdrawals)', or label 'New Allocator (controls withdrawals)'.
